races_in_feed: LiveResults: statewide, Congress, Legislature, Ohio Supreme Court and appeals courts; county and local races on the boards' own sites.
how_counted: Ohio reports early and absentee ballots received by 7:30 p.m. first, then Election Day votes; late absentee and provisional ballots come only in the canvass.
count_order: Early and absentee first, then Election Day; late absentee and provisional in the canvass.
vote_types: Yes in practice: Ohio reports all early and absentee ballots received by 7:30 p.m. first, then Election Day votes; late absentee and provisional ballots only in the canvass (Secretary's election-night FAQ, via search 2026-10-09). Strong count-order signal.

certify.rule: Federal and non-executive state offices: not later than 10 days after every county's abstract is in (Ohio Rev. Code 3505.35); executive offices are declared by the General Assembly (3505.34).
certify.local_rule: Boards complete the canvass by the 21st day (3505.32).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

scout_blocked: liveresults.ohiosos.gov (Cloudflare 403 to the script, 2026-10-09), www.ohiosos.gov and publicfiles.ohiosos.gov (Cloudflare challenge, CLAUDE.md), boe.ohio.gov boards and votehamiltoncountyohio.gov (Cloudflare).
scout_plan: Blocked for scripts on the night. Options for John: (a) he keeps LiveResults open in his browser and saves its download (if LiveResults offers one; check on the night of a test or in early November) into a folder, as for Minnesota; (b) the page links out to LiveResults with no numbers until the official canvass. County and local results: the boards' pages in the Secretary's directory, a few of which may answer scripts (test Butler, Cuyahoga, Franklin, Montgomery, Stark politely in late October). The 'early votes first' rule should be built into the count-order predictor.
